title: Discover more about me

intro.lead: I'm a <important>full-stack engineer</important> with a strong frontend foundation. I've worked in tech since 2016 and in software development since 2017.
intro.context: My work has ranged from Android apps and internal tools to delivery platforms and international products. I like understanding how things run and building tools that make people's work easier.

experienceHint: Open a company to see what I worked on there.

avenue-code.context: At Avenue Code, I work on Stellantis websites for brands such as Fiat and Ram. These applications receive millions of visits each month.
avenue-code.contribution: The work involves Vue.js, microfrontends and AEM integration, along with code reviews and delivery processes.

ciandt.context: I contributed to a B2B platform with more than 2.7 million monthly active users, operating in more than 18 countries.
ciandt.contribution: Alongside frontend development, I built internal tools to make difficult debugging workflows easier.

aiqfome.context: I joined as a frontend developer, also contributed to the backend and eventually became a tech lead. I helped with the integration into Magazine Luiza's ecosystem after the acquisition.
aiqfome.contribution: I started a frontend guild where the team could share knowledge, discuss solutions and help each other move past blockers.

superpao.context: I returned to Grupo Superpão as a developer, building internal systems and taking responsibility for BI reporting with QlikView.
superpao.contribution: I built an HR platform that managed more than 10,000 candidate profiles. I also helped reduce some issue resolution times from three days to under one hour.

rp-info.context: After graduation, I moved to Curitiba to work on native Android applications for supermarket systems.
rp-info.contribution: The role also involved backend and frontend development. That combination was my first full-stack experience.

beginnings.title: How it started
beginnings.p1: I've been interested in computers since I was a kid. Technology felt like a natural path, and I graduated in Systems Analysis and Development in 2017.
beginnings.p2: My first professional experience came a year earlier, in technical support for a supermarket chain. Android, internal systems and frontend development came after that.

teamwork.title: How I work with a team
teamwork.p1: I like building internal tools and creating room for people to share what they know. Helping someone work through a problem can matter just as much as shipping a feature.
teamwork.p2: I take part in code reviews, support other developers and work closely with product and design. I try to balance what the product needs with the quality of the code.

learning.title: What I'm learning now
learning.p1: I also work on products and solutions that use AI. It's an area I've been exploring through hands-on work.
learning.p2: I'm going deeper into LLM applications, RAG architectures and agents, building projects to understand these ideas and expand what I can deliver.

contact.prompt: Want to talk about a project?
contact.cta: Tell me a little about it.
